result.summary: Executed docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-030.md against branch feature/WF02-REQ-030 at commit 8f630bf. Wrote the new committed test file apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.forgery.test.ts (8 cases: AC1 abandon with column-level organizer-profile check, AC3 override-confirm, AC3 dismiss with direct audit_log query, AC4 differently-formatted-phone match, AC5 dynamic no-phone-leak on both admit and override-admit paths, AC6 genuine EventStaff-for-this-event fixture, cross-context forgery, malformed-message-text with two missing-prefix sub-variants), per this project's established TEST-DESIGNER-designs/TEST-RUNNER-writes convention (matching REQ-029's identical framing). tg_id range 943_000_000+, confirmed via grep -rn "nextTgId = " apps/bot/src to be distinct from every existing range including the pre-existing ISS-0026 collision (checkinQr.forgery.test.ts/walkin.db.test.ts both 942_000_000+), which this file does not touch or worsen. npm run lint: 0 errors (2 pre-existing apps/web /LCP warnings in Footer.tsx/Nav.tsx, unrelated to this change and its diff). npm run build: apps/web (Next.js 16.3.2, Turbopack) and apps/bot (tsc) both clean. npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism from the REPO ROOT (TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL against a freshly docker-composed + drizzle-kit-migrated scratch Postgres on port 55432): 31 test files / 308 tests passed, 0 failed -- up from the 300-test baseline by exactly the 8 new cases this run added. Ran the full suite twice to confirm the count is stable (308/308 both times); a standalone run of the new file alone showed a transient DB-pool-warmup skip of all 8 on its first invocation, immediately reproduced as a clean pass on retry with the Postgres container confirmed still running throughout -- attributed to connection-pool cold-start timing (a distinct, isolated `pg.Pool` construction with only a 3s connectionTimeoutMillis, racing the scratch DB right after a prior full-suite run had just closed 31 other pools), not a code defect; the authoritative, repeated, full-suite count is what is reported here. AC1 (independent, own fixture, organizer-profile column-level check): reply contains all three door-collected fields verbatim (Yerlan Toktarov/Silk Road Ventures/+996555112233); confirm button offered, never tapped; users/profiles/registrations row counts byte-identical before/after; organizer's own profiles row deep-equal (all columns) before vs. after, closing the gap a row-count-only check leaves open -- PASS. AC3 override-confirm (independent, own fixture Bota Suleimenova/Ruslan Abenov, capacity-1): override-offer message contains admitted/capacity numbers, exactly one override button; before the tap, 0 registrations for the second walk-in but users/profiles row already exists (Open Question 3); after the tap, exactly 1 registration (admitted/checked-in/manual), exactly 1 audit_log row action=registration.walkin_override_admit, payload.previousAdmission===null -- PASS. AC3 dismiss (independent, separate own fixture Damir Zhaksybekov/Aliya Mamedova): 0 registrations for the dismissed person; direct audit_log query (not registration-count) finds zero rows of either walk-in action referencing their userId; final reply === catalog.walkin.cancelled -- PASS. AC4 (independent, own two-format phone pair +77074445566 / "7 707 444-55-66", own names/companies distinct from BACKEND-DEV's pair): users/profiles counts unchanged after the second walk-in; stored company still the first walk-in's value ("Jibek Joly Trading"), second walk-in's "Wrong Co Name" discarded; exactly 2 registrations for the one resolved userId, both admitted -- PASS. AC5 (independent, dynamic own fixture covering BOTH plain-admit and override-admit paths, plus the static check): plain-admit audit payload excludes the phone value and the "phone" key; override-admit audit payload (forced via an own third walk-in at a filled event) equally excludes both -- BACKEND-DEV's own AC5 case only covers the plain-admit path. Static check: `git grep` for log./console. call sites in domain/walkin.ts and handlers/walkin.ts returns zero matches, confirming no logging call exists to leak a phone through -- PASS. AC6 (independent, genuine EventStaff-for-this-event fixture via a real addEventStaff row, distinct from BACKEND-DEV's "never staff anywhere" fixture): reply === catalog.walkin.notAuthorized; users/profiles/registrations counts unchanged; the refusal fires despite the real event_staff row's presence, proving EventStaff membership for this event is not accepted as sufficient authorization for a walk-in add -- PASS. Cross-context forgery (new, no prior coverage): organizer A (chapter A only) and organizer B (chapter B) seeded across two chapters; legitimate flow run as organizer B captures the real callback_data/message text; a forged dispatch using organizer A's own tgId with that SAME callback_data and text produces answerCallbackQuery show_alert=true, text===catalog.walkin.notAuthorized; zero registrations for the walk-in's userId; users/profiles counts unchanged by the forged tap; zero audit_log rows of any registration.walkin_* action referencing that userId -- confirms authorization is re-derived fresh from the TAPPING user's own chapter against the event's real chapterId read from callback_data, never from message content or the button's mere existence -- PASS. Malformed/corrupted message text (new, no prior coverage): sub-case A (missing "Phone: " line) and sub-case B (missing "Name: " line), same test: neither dispatch throws; both produce answerCallbackQuery show_alert=true, text===catalog.walkin.staleMessage; registrations/users/profiles counts unchanged in both -- confirms parseWalkinMessageFields's {ok:false} branch fires on any of the three missing fixed prefixes and never reaches commitWalkin -- PASS. AC2 not re-covered per the spec's own explicit closing note (BACKEND-DEV's own committed case has no found gap, mirrors REQ-029 precedent); confirmed still passing as part of the 308-test full-suite run. Full detail and real command output is in test-reports/report-2026-09-07-WF02-REQ-030.yaml.
